## ChatManager

`class` from [`src/network/Online/ChatManager.js`](../../../src/network/Online/ChatManager.js)

Reusable online text chat service connected to a `GameNetwork` session. It owns message normalization and system notices, while a game supplies its own canvas UI such as `ChatWindow`.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `network` | `GameNetwork` | Active high-level network session. |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Chat constraints. |
| `[options.maxLength=120]` | `number` | Maximum transmitted text length. |

### Methods

#### `sendMessage(text)`

Emits a local chat message and relays it to connected peers.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | User-entered message. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether non-empty text was accepted.

Subscribes to local, remote and system chat messages.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | Receives a normalized chat message. |

**Returns:** `Function` - Unsubscribe callback.
#### `addSystemMessage(text)`

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | Notice content. |

**Returns:** `void`

## GameNetwork

`class` from [`src/network/GameNetwork.js`](../../../src/network/GameNetwork.js)

High-level multiplayer session API built on a replaceable transport adapter. `GameNetwork` discovers peers in a room and forwards game-defined messages. It does not contain maps, entities or gameplay rules.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Initial network settings. |
| `[options.adapter=null]` | `Object\|null` | Adapter implementing connect, disconnect and send. |
| `[options.roomId="main"]` | `string` | Logical room shared by connected peers. |
| `[options.peer={}]` | `Object` | Local peer profile such as a display name. |

**Example**

```js
const network = new GameNetwork({
adapter: new LocalNetworkAdapter(),
peer: { name: "Ada" },
});
network.onPlayerStateReceived((peerId, state) => players.updateState(peerId, state));
network.connect();
```

### Methods

#### `useAdapter(adapter)`

Selects the transport used by this session.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `adapter` | `Object` | A LocalNetworkAdapter, WebSocketClientAdapter or compatible adapter. |

**Returns:** `GameNetwork` - This network instance.
#### `connect()`

Opens the selected adapter and starts peer discovery.

**Returns:** `GameNetwork` - This network instance.
#### `disconnect()`

Closes the adapter and forgets discovered remote peers.

**Returns:** `GameNetwork` - This network instance.

Updates the local public identity and informs connected peers.

| `profile` | `Object` | Public peer fields such as `name`. |

#### `send(type, payload = {})`

Sends an application message to peers in the current room.

**Parameters**

## LocalNetworkAdapter

`class` from [`src/network/Adapters/LocalNetworkAdapter.js`](../../../src/network/Adapters/LocalNetworkAdapter.js)

Same-origin multiplayer transport implemented with `BroadcastChannel`. It is useful for local demos and testing two browser tabs without an MMO backend. Messages remain scoped to a room and do not leave the browser.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Adapter settings. |
| `[options.roomId="main"]` | `string` | Channel room identifier. |
| `[options.peer={}]` | `Object` | Local public peer profile. |
| `[options.channelPrefix="gameforgejs-online"]` | `string` | Browser channel namespace. |

### Methods

#### `setPeer(peer)`

JSDoc pending.
#### `setRoom(roomId)`

JSDoc pending.
#### `connect()`

Opens the browser broadcast channel.

**Returns:** `LocalNetworkAdapter` - This adapter.
#### `send(type, payload = {})`

Broadcasts an envelope to the other tabs in this room.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | Message type. |
| `[payload={}]` | `Object` | Serializable message body. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether the channel was open.
#### `disconnect()`

Announces departure and releases the browser channel.

**Returns:** `LocalNetworkAdapter` - This adapter.

## NetworkClient

`class` from [`src/network/NetworkClient.js`](../../../src/network/NetworkClient.js)

Low-level WebSocket client for message envelopes and optional request/reply calls. Games normally consume `GameNetwork` and an adapter instead of this transport primitive directly.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Client connection settings. |

| `[options.autoConnect=false]` | `boolean` | Connect during construction. |
| `[options.autoReconnect=false]` | `boolean` | Retry unexpected connection losses. |

## NetworkStateSync

`class` from [`src/network/NetworkStateSync.js`](../../../src/network/NetworkStateSync.js)

Periodically broadcasts snapshots of small tracked objects through a network client. This generic helper reads and writes selected fields only; it has no knowledge of entities, maps or simulation.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[options]` | `Object` | Synchronization settings. |
| `[options.client=null]` | `NetworkClient\|null` | Client used to send snapshots. |
| `[options.channel="state:sync"]` | `string` | Envelope type for snapshots. |
| `[options.id]` | `string` | Local source identifier. |
| `[options.tickRate=20]` | `number` | Snapshot broadcasts per second. |

### Methods

#### `Track(id, { read, write = null } = {})`

Tracks state with game-provided reader and optional writer callbacks.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Entity identifier inside snapshots. |
| `callbacks` | `Object` | State callbacks. |
| `callbacks.read` | `Function` | Produces serializable state. |
| `[callbacks.write=null]` | `Function\|null` | Applies remote state. |

**Returns:** `NetworkStateSync` - This synchronizer.
#### `TrackObject(id, target, fields = ["position", "rotation", "scale"])`

Tracks common fields on a plain target object.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Entity identifier. |
| `target` | `Object` | Target object. |
| `[fields]` | `string[]` | Replicated property names. |

**Returns:** `NetworkStateSync` - This synchronizer.

## OnlineEntitySync

`class` from [`src/network/Online/OnlineEntitySync.js`](../../../src/network/Online/OnlineEntitySync.js)

Rate-limited sender for one game's local entity state. The game supplies `readState`, choosing the compact fields that remote peers need to render; unchanged snapshots are not resent.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `network` | `GameNetwork` | Session used to send player state. |
| `options` | `Object` | Entity synchronization settings. |
| `options.readState` | `Function` | Returns serializable local state. |
| `[options.syncRate=12]` | `number` | Maximum sends per second. |

### Methods

#### `update(deltaTime = 1 / 60)`

Advances the rate limiter and sends changed state when due.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[deltaTime=0.0166667]` | `number` | Frame time in seconds. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether state was sent.
#### `send(force = false)`

Immediately evaluates and optionally sends local state.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[force=false]` | `boolean` | Send even when fields did not change. |

**Returns:** `boolean` - Whether the network accepted a state message.
#### `changed(state)`

JSDoc pending.

`class` from [`src/network/Online/OnlinePlayerManager.js`](../../../src/network/Online/OnlinePlayerManager.js)

JSDoc pending.
